key_highlights: ASX slumps sharply as miners and banks sell off; oil hovers near US$100 amid Trump-Iran conflict, triggering TACO (trade assets, cash out) dynamics
Iron ore trouble spreads, pressuring BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; Chinese inflation surge raises demand concerns
AUD faces a 'shocker' as oil-driven inflation and RBA rate path uncertainty weigh on the currency
WA gold sector sees a wave of high-grade discoveries (Gateway, Golden Dragon, Auric, Forrestania) supporting junior miners
Copper hits record highs; Flagship ups Canadian copper stakes, positive for diversified miners
Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid; Bathla collapse ripples through private credit market
Australian business conditions weakest since pandemic; high-end property prices falling while affordable segment holds
Albo government sells gas reservation, signalling energy policy shift; data centre demand strains NSW power supply

sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness and Chinese inflation fears pressure BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; copper at records and WA gold discoveries support juniors (Gateway, Golden Dragon, Auric, Forrestania). Flagship ups copper exposure.
sectors.implications: Large-cap miners face near-term headwinds from iron ore; copper and gold names offer relative strength. Diversified exposure preferred.

sectors.trend: CBA.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX, WBC.AX sharply lower on ASX slump. Bathla collapse ripples through private credit. RBA rate path uncertain amid oil-driven inflation.
sectors.implications: NIM pressure from higher-for-longer rates vs credit risk from private credit stress. Defensive quality names (CBA, NAB) preferred over high-beta.

sectors.trend: Oil near US$100 on Trump-Iran war; Albo sells gas reservation. Data centre power demand strains NSW grid. Coal-to-data-centre pivot emerging.
sectors.implications: Positive for Woodside.AX, Santos.AX on gas policy shift. Energy infrastructure and power generators benefit from data centre demand.

sectors.trend: High-end homes see steepest falls; affordable segment resilient. NSW stamp duty hit threatens budget. Property chiefs call for more migrant labour.
sectors.implications: REITs (GP.AX, SPG.AX) face mixed signals. Residential builders pressured by labour shortage and policy uncertainty.

sectors.trend: Austal jumps on US$1.9b bid. AI data centre buildout at coal sites. UiPath/Pegasystems sink 7% on US tech weakness.
sectors.implications: ASX industrials (AUS.AX) see M&A tailwind. Data centre infrastructure plays gain strategic relevance.

sectors.trend: Business conditions weakest since pandemic. Consumer confidence deteriorating (NY Fed data). CSL.AX relatively insulated.
sectors.implications: Defensive consumer staples (WES.AX, WBC.AX) and healthcare (CSL.AX) offer relative safety in risk-off environment.

key_themes: Oil at US$100 and Iran conflict driving global risk-off and TACO dynamics
Iron ore demand concerns from Chinese inflation and slowdown
AUD weakness risk from oil-import inflation and RBA policy divergence
WA gold discovery wave supporting junior miners
Copper at record highs on supply constraints and data centre demand
Housing market bifurcation: luxury falling, affordable resilient
Energy transition tension: data centres vs decarbonisation
Private credit stress (Bathla) spilling into broader credit markets
Australian business conditions at pandemic lows

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil at US$100 / Iran conflict escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour domestic energy producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX) over oil-importing sectors. Monitor RBA response.
Reduce AUD-denominated foreign exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies. Consider AUD short hedges.
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX short-term; rotate into copper/gold-exposed names.
Review bank loan book quality; favour large-cap banks (CBA.AX, NAB.AX) with stronger capital buffers.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction in high-end segment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce exposure to luxury REITs and residential builders; monitor NSW stamp duty policy changes.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: NSW power supply adequacy / data centre demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor AGL.AX, CSG.AX, INC.AX for grid investment catalysts; watch for policy intervention.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight WA gold juniors on discovery wave
opportunities.rationale: Multiple high-grade hits (Gateway, Golden Dragon, Auric, Forrestania) signal a structural gold upcycle in WA Coolgardie; gold benefits from risk-off and AUD weakness.

opportunities.recommendation: Add copper-exposed miners on record prices
opportunities.rationale: Copper at all-time highs with 'more left in the tank'; Flagship ups Canadian stakes. Data centre buildout drives structural demand.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in domestic energy on gas policy shift
opportunities.rationale: Albo selling gas reservation signals pro-production stance; oil at $100 supports upstream cash flows.

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL.AX and WES.AX
opportunities.rationale: Business conditions at pandemic lows; consumer and healthcare defensives offer relative outperformance in risk-off.

defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading; Chinese inflation and demand concerns create near-term headwinds for BHP, RIO, FMG.
AUD shocker looms on oil-import inflation; RBA may be forced to hold or hike, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid private credit and high-yield exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals broader private credit stress; contagion risk to bank loan books.
Steepest price falls at high end; NSW stamp duty hit threatens yields and occupancy.

market_outlook.short_term: ASX 200 (^AXJO) likely to remain under pressure over 1–3 months. Oil at $100, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation create a risk-off backdrop. RBA policy uncertainty adds volatility. Gold and copper names provide relative strength. Expect 3–5% downside risk on ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6–12 month outlook cautiously constructive if oil normalises and Chinese demand stabilises. Structural themes (copper, gold, data centre power demand, gas production) support selective outperformance. Housing bifurcation continues; affordable segment resilient. Business conditions may bottom in H1 2027.

BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX production and guidance
